B wins because it sets out a clear fix order, names what already works in the flow (including the one-nudge-a-day promise) and gives a fuller vocabulary list with one consistent recommendation. B spreads the vocabulary issue across several items, says 'everywhere else the word is plant' (not accurate), and says little about what works, though it does flag the playful emoji against the plain tone of the earlier screens.
